faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mizoram University Senior Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA in a relevant branch of Biological Sciences, along with 04 years of post-graduate R&D experience, or a PhD in a relevant branch of Biological Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate position is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000 plus HRA (9%).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Mizoram University Senior Project Associate job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Senior Project Associate position is a contractual role at Mizoram University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Mizoram University located?
faq.answer: Mizoram University is located in Aizawl, Mizoram, with the pincode 796004.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
